items.name: Ohio State Expo Open 2022

venue.name: Friday: [Ohio Union Senate Chamber](https://ohiounion.osu.edu), Saturday/Sunday:  [Rhodes Center](https://ohioexpocenter.com/rental-facilities/rhodes-center)
venue.address: 1739 N. High Street, Columbus, Ohio 43210, 717 E 17th Ave, Columbus, OH 43211
venue.details: Senate Chamber is located on the second floor of the Ohio Union, Rhodes Center is located at the Ohio Expo Center

items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: ** * **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw** * **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending** * **Competition as a whole is cancelled** * **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate** **We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

items.name: Vännäs & Friends 2022
items.information: **Svenska** Välkommna till Vännäsby och den nordligaste tävlingen i Sverige sedan 2015! Detta är första gången en tävling hålls i Umeå-området. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Notera särskilt fliken "Resa", som innehåller mycket användbara tips för att spara pengar på resan till Vännäsby. *Om du inte tävlar i 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD behöver du inte närvara under fredagen* **English** Welcome to Vännäsby and the northernmost competetion in Sweden since 2015! This is the first time a competetion is held in the Umeå-area. Please read through all the tabs on this page such that you do not miss any important information. Note in particular the tab "Travel", which contains very useful tips to save money on the trip to Vännäsby. *If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present on Friday*
